arguments.evidence:
State after this session (all offline, real PAL corpus, each with an immutable result, tests and a Jev claim check):
DONE and committed locally (not pushed): (1) verify_audio: 305 bank spans + 20 music streams obey PS-ADPCM structure; decoder matches ffmpeg exactly on all 305 spans and 40 music excerpts (first decoder was falsified and corrected). (2) verify_ptg: universal header relations on 548/548 files; exact layout for 17 DD-trailer files; palette/tile-pointer/descriptor semantics unresolved. (3) verify_model: leading u32 == name-pool end 56/56; geometry unresolved. (4) DS_Store verifier fix.
Unresolved with measured leads: PTG palette location and tile pointer meaning (pointers are not file offsets; descriptors constant; raw-index render shows a recognizable logo); model geometry (16-bit index runs seen); .mih word1 meaning; flag/loop behavior of music; 491 header-only PTG files.
Not yet probed: UI/text/cfg grammars (216 .dat, 45 .ui, 16 .cfg, 5 .mbf; no measurement yet); EE/IOP/VU consumers (3446 functions inventoried, loader stages mapped, consumers unmapped).
Constraints: no debugger windows or focus stealing (static/offline only); milestone-#2 evidence unchanged; the user's broader finish line is not established (issue #2 lists audio codec, mesh, full PTG, UI/text as separate investigations; handoff says resolve scope with one focused question and not to invent a mandate); public posting and push need explicit permission.
Remaining work required regardless of choice: completion matrix and criteria, evidence bundle, independent code review, final Jev gate.
